data.name: Shreyas
data.gender_notes: Shreyas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shreyas is derived from the Sanskrit word shri which means prosperity, wealth, and success. It is a name given to a boy with the hope that he will bring prosperity and success in his family and in his life. The name Shreyas carries the meaning “Achievement, Success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shreyas usually hope their child will grow to embody achievement, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shreyas is also considered to be a divine name in Hinduism. It is believed that the god Shri Ganesha is fond of the name Shreyas and blesses those who are named after him with prosperity and success.
data.etymology: Shreyas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Achievement, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shreyas total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
